## ⚙️ Build Instructions
* **CMake:** Version 3.20 or higher.
* **Compiler:** C++20 compatible (MSVC 2022).
* **Git:** Required for submodule management.
* **vcpkg** Required for detours.
* **Dependencies:** DirectX SDK (D3D11/DXGI)

> [!IMPORTANT]
> For a visual guide on required Visual Studio components, refer to **[Install.md](Install.md)**.

---

### Compilation Steps

1. **Clone the Repository** (including submodules):
	```bash
	git clone --recursive --branch development --single-branch https://github.com/monakaibrahim-cmyk/hsr-cheese.git
	cd hsr-cheese
	```

2. Build the Project:
	run `build.bat`

The resulting library (`Cheat.dll`) will be located in the `build/Debug` directory.
